verdict.rationale: Wave explicitly documents role-based access for accountants/bookkeepers ('Add multiple users, such as your bookkeeper or accountant') and defines specific scoped roles ('admin, editor, or viewer (Pro)', plus free payroll manager/tax pro roles) for granting trusted collaborators access. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the invite flow or evidence of granular permission enforcement (e.g., what a 'viewer' vs 'editor' can actually adjust).
